# Apply report — #104 AC1 registry identity (continuation)

**Status:** completed  
**Branch:** `fix/issue-104-npm-identity`  
**AC1 commit:** `68bafc6af8c2e46fe8ca7ca23a94281c41eb8d8a`  
**Prior baseline (AC2–AC5):** `625110d`  
**Authority:** plan-court converged r1+r2+r3; continuation task after ENEEDAUTH cleared (`npm whoami` → `akagilnc`)

## AC1 decision

| Axis | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Auth | `npm whoami` → `akagilnc` (ENEEDAUTH cleared) |
| Candidate `@ak/pi-workflow-roles` | **Unpublishable** by this login |
| Settled name | `@akagilnc/pi-workflow-roles` (documented fallback #1) |
| Publish | **not performed** (read-only probes only) |

### Authenticated evidence (read-only)

| Probe | Result | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `npm whoami` | `akagilnc` | Authenticated |
| `npm view @ak/pi-workflow-roles` | `E404` | Name free on registry ≠ publish rights |
| `npm org ls ak` | `{"ak":"owner"}` | Scope/org `ak` exists; sole member is user `ak`, **not** `akagilnc` |
| `npm access list packages @ak` | `{}` | No packages under `@ak` for this login |
| `npm access list collaborators @ak/pi-workflow-roles` | **`E403` Forbidden** | Same class as foreign scope (`@types/nonexistent` → `E403`) |
| `npm view @akagilnc/pi-workflow-roles` | `E404` | Fallback #1 free |
| `npm access list collaborators @akagilnc/pi-workflow-roles` | **`E404` Package not found** | Own-scope absent package (not `E403`) |
| `npm view ak-pi-workflow-roles` | `E404` | Fallback #2 free; not needed |

**Decision table application:** authenticated evidence shows current name unpublishable → apply fallback order item 1 → rename to `@akagilnc/pi-workflow-roles` via forward commit; evidence trail recorded in `docs/npm-identity.md`.

## Files changed in `68bafc6`

- `package.json` / `package-lock.json` — `name` → `@akagilnc/pi-workflow-roles`
- `docs/npm-identity.md` — settled name + full probe table + applied fallback
- `test/helpers/pi-test-harness.ts` — cold-install dependency key + `node_modules/…` path
- `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`, `README.md`, `CONTEXT.md` — package-name self-references

Historical research archive (`docs/research/issue-26-reconciliation.json`) left unchanged (past evidence, not live identity).

## Gates

- `npm run typecheck` — pass  
- `npm run test:fast` — **271 pass / 0 fail**  
- `npm run test:all` — **348 pass / 0 fail** (~97s)

## TDD / same-pattern / regression / behavior-fact (AC1 slice)

**TDD:** AC1 is registry-evidence + identity rename, not a new behavioral seam. Existing pack seam already asserts `extracted.packageJson.name === sourceManifest.name` (`test/package/npm-identity-metadata.test.ts`); green under the renamed manifest. Cold-install path strings updated to match npm’s scoped install layout for the new name (same harness pattern).

**Same-pattern:** Reused documented fallback order and maintainer note surface from prior leg; no parallel identity mechanism; no publish; no invented names outside fallback list.

**Introduced-regression:** Full `test:all` green after rename. Unrelated `dist/` rebuild drift from pack runs restored (not committed). Working tree clean at HEAD.

**Behavior-fact check:**

| Claim | Fact |
| --- | --- |
| Settled package name | `package.json` `"name": "@akagilnc/pi-workflow-roles"` |
| Why not `@ak/…` | Org member `ak` only; collaborators `E403` under auth |
| Why fallback #1 | Own-scope collaborators `E404`; name free; first in documented order |
| npm publish | Not run |
| AC2–AC5 | Unchanged from `625110d`; still in force |

## AC checklist (ticket #104)

| AC | Result |
| --- | --- |
| AC1 Registry identity | **done** at `68bafc6` |
| AC2 Apache-2.0 license | done at `625110d` |
| AC3 Separate Matt MIT notice | done at `625110d` |
| AC4 Explicit peers + matrix | done at `625110d` |
| AC5 Packed metadata via npm pack seam | done at `625110d` (name assertion tracks source manifest) |

## Out of scope (honored)

No `npm publish`; no names outside documented fallback order; forward commit only; no skill bodies; no CLI; no product README invocation rewrite beyond the package-title self-reference required by the rename.
